title_en: Urine Trouble: PEE V PEE Brings Unhinged Multiplayer Action to IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026 with a Hilarious First Look at Its Absurd Premise
summary_en: Get a first look at Urine Trouble: PEE V PEE with the new gameplay reveal from IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026, showcasing its hilarious multiplayer action.
body_en:
Some people think there aren't enough games about peeing on Steam these days. Those people decided to do something about it, and lo, Urine Trouble: PEE V PEE was born. IGN Fall Fan Fest 2026 showed off a trailer for the game, which is absolutely as moist as it sounds.
The aim? Pee on everything. Players - or Pissers, as they're called in the game - have to race around the map trying to golden shower items to claim them before anyone else can, like buildings, cars, and fountains, waggling their, um, appendages and generally causing chaos. If weaponized incontinence doesn't appeal to you, you can always play as the police hunting down the Pissers instead.
You can wishlist the game on Steam now.
Fall Fan Fest has 90 exclusive reveals across games, movies, TV, comics, and collectibles. Stream it on IGN to see game announcements, trailers, exclusive clips, celebrity interviews, and more or catch up on anything you missed from Fall Fan Fest right here on IGN.
Rachel Weber is the Head of Editorial Development at IGN and an elder millennial. She's been a professional nerd since 2006 when she got her start on Official PlayStation Magazine in the UK, and has since worked for GamesIndustry.Biz, Rolling Stone and GamesRadar. She loves horror, horror movies, horror games, Red Dead Redemption 2, and her Love and Deepspace boyfriends.
